title: feat(service-settings,plugin-audit,plugin-sharing): config_change rows name their settings row; record pages for audit rows and queues
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1sr8NvtKQ3yTjysfPXCrvF)_

Refs #30209

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置写入的 `config_change` 审计行现在把被改的设置行 id 写进 `record_id`；`sys_audit_log` 新增默认记录页，列出「同一记录的其他变更」；`sys_queue` 新增默认记录页，成员列表按队列 `name` 过滤，「新建」预填队列名。
- 为什么改：#30209 第 4 行 B 与第 6 行 B 的裁定（6670358877）。审计行有了 `record_id`，记录页就能把同一设置行的镜像 create/update 行（带非机密明文值）摆在一起；队列成员按名字存，记录页才能直接管成员。
- 风险与回滚：⚠ 读权限收窄：新的 `config_change` 行有了 `record_id`，就归父记录读门管，只持有审计台账读授权、读不到设置表的人从此看不到新的 `config_change` 行（管理员及持 `view_all_audit_log` 者照看；旧行 `record_id` 为空，照旧可见）。席位已接受此后果，维护者可在本 PR 否决。其余是新增页面，不改 `sys_queue_member.queue`，不碰 spec 与 ui。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` 的 `upsertRow` 与 `config-change-audit.ts` 的 `record_id`；`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/sys-audit-log.page.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sys-queue.page.ts`；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/audit-log-parent-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` 新增的读门用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/sys-queue-page.test.ts`（8 条全绿）与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/config-change-audit.test.ts`（18 条全绿）。
- 需要你做的：确认是否接受上面的读权限收窄；声明队列（包里声明的队列）不在本 PR 范围。

## What changes

**Row 4 B: a `config_change` row names the settings row it changed, and an audit row's record page lists the other changes to the same record.**

- `@objectstack/service-settings`: `SettingsService.upsertRow` returns the stored row's id (`rowId`) from the update branch (the probed row) and the insert branch (the inserted row), and null on the in-memory paths. The audit call passes it as `recordId`, a new optional field on the `SettingsAuditSink.record` entry, and `buildConfigChangeAuditSink` writes it to `record_id`. `object_name` already named the store (`sys_setting`, or `sys_platform_setting` for a global value). `metadata` and the digest in `new_value` are unchanged.
- `@objectstack/plugin-audit`: a default full record page for `sys_audit_log` (`sys_audit_log_detail`, served through the plugin manifest's `pages`). It draws every field but `id` in the object's own field groups, and a `record:related_list` over `sys_audit_log` with `relationshipField` and `relationshipValueField` both `record_id`, newest first, with `actions: []` so there is no "New" on the append-only ledger. The page label is translated in all eleven locales (`translations/pages.ts`, wired through `withSourceFallback` with recorded source hashes and declared in the extract config).
- The #24611 comment in `sys-audit-log.object.ts` and the row-class prose in `audit-log-read-visibility.ts` now say `config_change` rows name their settings row, and that older `config_change` rows (and `import` rows) do not. The gate code is unchanged.

**Row 6 B: a queue's record page lists its members.**

- `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`: a default full record page for `sys_queue` (`sys_queue_detail`). Its members list reads `sys_queue_member` with `relationshipField: 'queue'` and `relationshipValueField: 'name'`, so the console filters on `queue` equal to this queue's `name` and its "New" opens the member form with `queue` filled in with that name. `sys_queue_member.queue` is unchanged. The page label ships in the plugin's four locales.
- Declared queues are out: a package's queue is a registry item with no `sys_queue` row, so it has no record page. Its organization's member rows stay on the Queue Members list.

## Tests

- `service-settings/src/config-change-audit.test.ts` (18 pass): the global case pins `record_id` to the `sys_platform_setting` row's id, the tenant case to the `sys_setting` row's id (the re-pin near the old L386), and a new case writes, overwrites and clears one key: one stored row, three ledger rows with the same `record_id`, and `metadata` keys exactly as before.
- `plugin-audit/src/sys-audit-log-page.test.ts` (10 pass): the manifest carries the page; `PageSchema` and each node's `ComponentPropsMap` row parse it (with a control the door refuses); the details cover every field but `id`; the list props; the eleven locales.
- `plugin-audit/src/sys-audit-log-same-record.integration.test.ts` (6 pass), on ObjectQL, the SQLite driver and the real CRUD mirror, with the filter read off the page: beside a global `config_change` row the list holds both `config_change` rows and the mirror's create and update; the mirror's update carries the old and new value in plain text (the measure-first reading: yes); a tenant row lists only its own rows; a secret's mirror row carries neither the value nor its handle.
- `plugin-sharing/src/sys-queue-page.test.ts` (8 pass), on ObjectQL and SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite: the filter `{ queue: queue.name }` read off the page lists that queue's members and no other's (control: keyed on the id it finds nothing); the "New" prefill `{ queue: 'billing' }` saves a member the list shows; and the list agrees with `OwnershipQueueService.resolveQueue` on the members.
- Dogfood (both run, 14 of 14 pass): `settings-config-change-audit.dogfood.test.ts` adds an end-to-end pin that `PUT /api/settings/branding` writes a `config_change` row whose `record_id` is the stored `sys_setting` row's id, with the mirror's row about the same write beside it carrying the value. `audit-log-parent-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` moves its run-level row to an object-less action invocation (the settings write no longer supplies one, and this boot has no other run-level producer), and adds a pin that the `config_change` row follows the gate on its settings row: the ledger-only reader gets 404, the admin 200.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty: `record_id: entry.recordId ?? null` to `record_id: null` turns 3 `config-change-audit` cases red; the queue page's `relationshipValueField: 'name'` to `'id'` turns 4 `sys-queue-page` cases red.
- Full suites: `@objectstack/service-settings` 69 files, 1179 tests; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 75 files, 1161 tests; `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` 67 files, 1417 tests; all pass, and `tsc --noEmit` exits 0 in each.

## Acceptance notes

- **Read narrowing, accepted by the seat.** A reader who holds only the ledger's read grant no longer sees new `config_change` rows unless it can read the settings row they name. Holders of `view_all_audit_log` see every row. The changeset and the 风险 line say this so the maintainer can veto it here.
- **Where the page is reached.** Setup's Audit Logs entry opens the `audit:log` browser drawer, not this record page. The page opens from the object's list and from record links. Linking the drawer to the page is a ui change, outside this PR.
- **No ui fallback was needed.** The console's related list has no limit on a self-referencing list. A row with no `record_id` sends no query and shows the empty state. The list includes the row being read.
- **Left unchanged:** the `config_changes` list view's columns; the fixture in `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts`, whose null-`record_id` `config_change` row tests `tenant_id`, not the record pointer; and open PR #30448, which edits `setMany`'s env-lock branch in the same file but not `upsertRow` or the audit call.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 commands on head f6c2de44 (origin/main merged in). Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 69 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the first pass (shallow clone, the pinned fixture commit unreachable); after fetching `621a4876` it exits 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 69 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
